policy.fixture: Unchanged full-frame fixture; Beethoven, seed 417, fill .8, real visuals, disabled note scheduler, synthetic music clock; full desktop only.
policy.temporalScope: 28 fixed rotation steps plus five sampled transition times; not continuous real-time playback or a complete 4-second viewing test.
policy.checkpointPolicy: Four passes at each exact dome/music/camera time exercise update requests for both slots at medium every=2 alternating cadence. Preserve all passes, capture the fourth; normal return does not prove fresh pixels.
policy.timing: completeMs includes renderer probes/state reads and readPixels; diagnostics only, never FPS or an uninstrumented A/B performance claim.
policy.faceScope: Observed cube renderer.render requests/normal returns plus the product-equivalent 11x9 rule for first-use request coverage. Not proof of actual proxy mesh draws, world program readiness, fresh/visible pixels, or minimal masks. No private slot access or VRAM inference. Product intentionally excludes -Y.
policy.quality: Node-requested preset, renderScale=1, expected renderer pixelRatio and cube size are checked against meta, every warmup sample, and every motion sample/input/output; page lexical quality is observation only.
policy.restoration: Checks the state actually encountered by drawWorlds and temporary probe hooks; does not inject renderer exceptions or nondefault target/XR state.

initialReadiness.policy: Existing UI readiness and dome visibility, never forced visible.
